# GenderAPI.io

GenderAPI.io provides an API to determine the gender associated with a given name, email address, or username.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/genderapi-io/.

## Actions

- **Get Gender from Username** (read-only): Determine gender from a username or nickname.
- **Query gender by email address** (read-only): Determine gender from an email address.
- **Query Gender by First Name** (read-only): Determine gender by querying first name.
- **Query Gender by Full Name** (read-only): Determine gender from a full name.
- **Gender API Get Statistics** (read-only): Retrieve account usage statistics from GenderAPI.io.
- **List Gender API Error Codes** (read-only): List all possible error codes returned by Gender API.
